kernel: the GatedDeltaNet decode and verify kernels of src/gdn_decode.zig: K1 msv_gdn_decode_recur (conv, SiLU, q/k norm, gate chain and delta recurrence in one launch, one head over SPLIT=4 threadgroups of 256 threads, each recomputing its head's prework before its slice of the recurrence rows), K2 msv_gdn_decode_normgate_rot (per-head gated RMS norm over one Hadamard block, then the out_proj rotation via signs and an in-threadgroup Walsh-Hadamard transform), K1S msv_gdn_decode_recur_seq (the same per-token prework and recurrence token after token over 1 to 16 rows, with the per-step state capture rollback reads), the fold msv_gdn_decode_recur_seq_fold (recurrence + norm-gate + conv-input concat in one 1024-thread launch per head, 1 to 8 rows), the tree pair msv_gdn_decode_tree_pre + msv_gdn_decode_tree (one simdgroup per (head, row) prework job, then a parents-first walk with one dv row per simdgroup and restart states in registers), and msv_gdn_decode_replay (the commit: the recurrence along the kept path from the round's input state, plus the conv-window copy, in the same launch)
summary: Serves the GatedDeltaNet layers' single-token step and the speculative verify rows on Metal. Serial decode is one dispatch (recur, K1 alone) or two (step, K1 + K2) per layer: each head's DV rows split over 4 threadgroups that recompute the conv, SiLU and q/k norm prework for their head because the recompute is cheaper than a barrier, and Hadamard packs get the gated RMS norm plus rotation in K2. Verify runs the same per-token arithmetic over up to 16 rows with the state rounded to its stored dtype after every token, as a chain (recurSeq or the fold, with per-step state capture) or a draft tree (recurTree + replay, restart states in registers, no capture).

models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next 27B
models.quant: mixed 4-8 bit MLX affine; GDN activations bf16 over an f32 recurrent state by default (MLX_SERVE_GDN_STATE_F32=0 restores bf16)
models.family: qwen4_exp (their model_type; inside our dense qwen3_5 span)
models.role: primary: the -3.9 percent GDN fusion figure was measured on it, and its GDN geometry is Hk 16, Hv 48, dk = dv = 128 (src/transformer.zig:65327)

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.role: the 106 tok/s dflash install whose GDN layers take the row-exact arm of these kernels under a DFlash2 drafter

models.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B
models.quant: 2-bit ternary affine; f32 GDN state (src/transformer.zig:56865 names Bonsai 2 for the StT = float instantiation)
models.role: secondary: a no-Hadamard pack, so its verify rows take recurSeq / recurTree / replay

settings.name: split_threadgroups_per_head
settings.condition: K1 and K1S: each head's DV rows split over SPLIT threadgroups; the fold kernel passes template SPLIT 1 (one threadgroup per head)
settings.note: grid hv * SPLIT * NT threads with NT-sized threadgroups (src/gdn_decode.zig:496-497); hv = threadgroup_position_in_grid.x / SPLIT, part = the remainder (src/gdn_decode.zig:36-37); fold SPLIT at src/gdn_decode.zig:893

settings.name: k1_threads_per_threadgroup
settings.condition: K1 serial decode, and K1S off NAX
settings.note: 8 simdgroups; their comment: 4 dv rows per simdgroup

settings.name: k1_rows_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: K1 at NT 256 and DV 128
settings.note: R = RB / NSG = (DV / SPLIT) / (NT / 32) = (128 / 4) / 8 = 4; RB at src/gdn_decode.zig:31

settings.name: seq_threads_nax
settings.condition: K1S (recurSeq) and the fold on NAX hosts; other GPUs cap this kernel's threadgroup below 1024 and keep K1's 256
settings.note: seqNt() reads transformer.zig's naxAvailable(); their comment (src/gdn_decode.zig:415-418): a token's rows then take one reduction pair in sequence, not four, and a row's arithmetic is the same, so the rows are bit-identical either way

settings.name: seq_rows_per_simdgroup_nax
settings.condition: K1S on NAX (seqNt 1024); 4 off NAX

settings.name: fold_threads_per_threadgroup
settings.condition: recurSeqFold only: one threadgroup per head; a GPU whose pipeline grants fewer threads declines it cleanly at first dispatch and the caller keeps the unfolded chain
settings.note: fold_ok latch at src/gdn_decode.zig:945-955; 2048 is named as exceeding every GPU's limit (test-seam comment src/gdn_decode.zig:862)

settings.name: fold_max_rows
settings.condition: recurSeqFold only; their comment: the fold keeps a head's y rows in threadgroup memory beside K1S's q/k/v rows, past 8 they pass 32 KB

settings.name: max_verify_rows
settings.condition: recurSeq and recurTree t_len bound (MAX_SEQ); the state_seq capture has T rows

settings.name: key_head_dim
settings.condition: every kernel in this file declines other geometries
settings.note: the recur gate; the multi-token and replay gates repeat dk/dv 128 and hv % hk == 0 without the hv*dv % 1024 clause (src/gdn_decode.zig:621, 816)

settings.name: value_head_dim
settings.condition: every kernel in this file declines other geometries

settings.name: state_layout
settings.value: [1, Hv, Dv, Dk] row-major, batch 1; lane-addressed as (hv * DV + dv) * DK + lane * 4, 4 channels per lane
settings.condition: K1, K1S, the tree walk and replay all index it the same way

settings.name: capture_layout
settings.value: [T, 1, Hv, Dv, Dk], row T-1 never written (partial accept reads at most T-2)
settings.condition: recurSeq and the fold, the state_seq output rollback slices
settings.note: comment src/gdn_decode.zig:151-153 and the t + 1 < TL guard at 246; the capture-tail trim story is docs/gotchas/engine-mlx.md:296

settings.name: state_dtypes
settings.value: StT = the activation dtype or float32; every kernel instantiates T (activations), StT (state) and GT (decay gate) as separate template dtypes
settings.condition: recurSeq, recurTree, recurSeqFold and replay; K1 the same (src/gdn_decode.zig:535)

settings.name: per_token_state_rounding
settings.value: st = float(static_cast<StT>(st)) after every token inside the kernel
settings.condition: K1S recurrence (src/gdn_decode.zig:244), the tree walk (src/gdn_decode.zig:378) and replay (src/gdn_decode.zig:408); the serial K1 rounds once at the store (src/gdn_decode.zig:103)
settings.note: their comment: the next token reads the state serial decoding stored (StT), not the f32; this is what makes a T-row window equal T one-row calls, pinned by the test at src/transformer.zig:65223

settings.name: gate_dtype_rule
settings.value: GT = the state dtype under bf16 activations, else the activation dtype (f16 Hadamard packs keep their measured f16 gate)
settings.condition: the decay gate a + dt_bias -> g in every kernel here
settings.note: their comment (src/gdn_decode.zig:22-24): a bf16 gate near one is exactly 1.0 and that head never forgets

settings.name: state_f32_default_flash_next
settings.condition: qwen4_exp (Flash Next): config.ssm_state_f32 = gdnStateF32Enabled(), on unless MLX_SERVE_GDN_STATE_F32=0; Hadamard packs and GLM-5 are f32 state regardless of the flag
settings.note: ssmStateDtype at src/model.zig:1190, the env default at 2152-2160

settings.name: qk_norm_eps_k1
settings.condition: K1 and K1S prework q/k RMS norm: precise::rsqrt(sumsq / DK + 1e-6f)
settings.note: K2's norm eps is a runtime 0-dim f32 array (cfg.rms_norm_eps), not a constant (src/gdn_decode.zig:120)

settings.name: conv_taps
settings.condition: conv width 4: three conv-state rows plus the current qkv row; conv_w holds 4 * C weights
settings.note: K1 uses taps 0..2 from conv_state plus qkv (src/gdn_decode.zig:54-56); K1S addresses taps t..t+3 across the conv-state and qkv rows (src/gdn_decode.zig:182-186); conv_state is [1, 3, C] (src/gdn_decode.zig:443)

settings.name: k2_threads_per_threadgroup
settings.condition: K2 norm-gate + rotation: grid (Hv * Dv / block) * 128 threads
settings.note: S = 4 simdgroups do the final rotation store, P = J / S with J = block / 32 (src/gdn_decode.zig:109)

settings.name: hadamard_block_values
settings.condition: step() only; the block must also divide Hv * Dv and be a multiple of 4 * Dv (= 512)
settings.note: step's checks at src/gdn_decode.zig:566; the 27B Hadamard pack uses 1024, 2B/4B use 512, 9B uses 4096 (docs/gotchas/engine-mlx.md:5704)

settings.name: k2_rotation_scale
settings.condition: K2 output store, after the threadgroup and simdgroup butterflies
settings.note: rsqrt(float(J * 32)) with J = block / 32; the rot output is rounded once to T (src/gdn_decode.zig:147)

settings.name: tree_prework_launch
settings.value: grid (32, 2 * HK + HV, TL), threadgroup (32, 1, 1): one simdgroup per (head, row) job, q/k/v columns read in place from the joined projection
settings.condition: recurTree's first launch (msv_gdn_decode_tree_pre)

settings.name: tree_walk_launch
settings.value: grid (32, DV, HV), threadgroup (32, 4, 1) = 128 threads: one dv row per simdgroup, rows walked parents first
settings.condition: recurTree's second launch (msv_gdn_decode_tree); replay uses the same shape (src/gdn_decode.zig:831-832)

settings.name: tree_prework_precision
settings.condition: pq, pk, pv, pg stored f32 between the two tree launches
settings.note: k [T, Hk, Dk], v [T, Hv, Dv], g and beta packed [T, Hv, 2], all .float32 (src/gdn_decode.zig:682-685)

settings.name: tree_restart_states
settings.value: kept[TL][4] per lane in registers; row t restarts from kept[parent] when parent != t - 1, and kept[t] is stored only when the table's restart flag is set
settings.condition: the tree walk only; a chain never restarts (parent is always t - 1)
settings.note: restart test at src/gdn_decode.zig:367-368, conditional kept store at 379; per-token rounding still applies before the kept store

settings.name: tree_table_layout
settings.value: 6 * T int32: parents (-1 = root), then 4 conv-source rows per row (a value under 3 is a conv-state row, 3 + r a window row), then one restart flag per row
settings.condition: recurTree's table from treeTable, resolved on the host once instead of per channel
settings.note: treeTable body at src/gdn_decode.zig:767-792: parents at [0, n), conv rows at [n, n + 4n), restart flags at [5n, 6n)

gates.condition: Hadamard-pack serial decode takes gdn_decode.step: rht != null and batch == 1 and seq_len == 1 and projected == null and !skip_output and !spec_capture_ssm and ssm initialized and kernel == 4 and no KDA vector gate or bounded gate and not kda_sigmoid_out_gate

Packs without a Hadamard rotation, serial decode takes recur plus the fused norm-gate epilogue: rht == null and batch == 1 and seq_len == 1 and projected == null and !spec_capture_ssm and kernel == 4 and gdnDecodeRecurEnabled()

MTP verify rows (spec_capture_ssm) take this file only at rht == null, batch 1, 1 <= seq_len <= 16 and kernel == 4: a chain tries recurSeqFold first (src/transformer.zig:31629), a draft tree takes recurTree (src/transformer.zig:31646), the unfolded chain recurSeq (src/transformer.zig:31675)

gdnDecodeRecurEnabled: MLX_SERVE_GDN_DECODE_RECUR=0 disables, and it additionally requires gdnDecodeFusedEnabled (MLX_SERVE_GDN_DECODE_FUSED, same 0-to-disable form); MLX_SERVE_GDN_VERIFY_FOLD=0 keeps the unfolded recurSeq chain
recur kernel geometry: dk == 128 and dv == 128 and hv % hk == 0 and hv*dv % 1024 == 0
multi-token kernels (recurSeq, recurTree, replay) geometry: 1 <= t_len <= 16 and dk == 128 and dv == 128 and hv % hk == 0; the hv*dv % 1024 clause is recur's only

input dtypes: activations bf16 or f16; a, b, conv_state, conv_w, A_log, dt_bias, q_scale, k_scale all the activation dtype; the state its dtype or float32; per-token rows exactly [1, T, width] and weights/states exactly the indexed element counts (inputsFit)
step() block gates: rht.kernelBlock(block) and hv*dv % block == 0 and block % (4*dv) == 0
replay gates: nonempty path and prework bound, dk/dv 128, hv % hk == 0, conv_input [1, rows, C] with 3*C <= 32*Dv*Hv, conv rows in range
joined in-projection read in place: its dtype matches the activation dtype and a_off, b_off sit at or past C and within the row width

notes: Doc-vs-source, sided with the source: (1) our doc's GDN-section bullet attributes the per-token prework, the per-step state capture and the T-row-equals-T-one-row property to 'the verify form'; in the source that description is recurSeq (K1S, msv_gdn_decode_recur_seq), the chain form, whose capture is [T, 1, Hv, Dv, Dk] (B = 1). recurTree (K1P + K1TR) writes no per-step capture: it keeps restart states in registers and its rollback replays the kept path from the round's input state via replay, with the conv window copied in the same launch. Our doc's row-exact section describes the tree correctly; the GDN-section bullet conflates the two forms. (2) The dispatch gates split the file in two: step (K1 + K2 with the Hadamard rotation) requires a Hadamard pack (rht != null) and serves only serial seq_len 1; recurSeq, recurTree, replay and the fold require the opposite (rht == null). On Hadamard packs the verify rows stay on the composed chain, so our doc's single continuous story (two-dispatch decode, then the verify form) is really two pack flavors. (3) The 3.9 percent figure: upstream measured it on the composed-chain fusion gdnPreworkFused + gdnNormGateFused in transformer.zig (MLX_SERVE_GDN_DECODE_FUSED), not on this file's two-dispatch form; our doc's 'three fused GDN decode dispatches per layer, 3.9 percent of a Flash Next forward' cites it for the fusion family, and the KAPITSA item 9 comparison should quote it with that scope. (4) License: our doc's pinned section says Apache-2.0; the repo's LICENSE is MIT (LICENSE:1, Copyright 2026 David Dalcu) with LICENSE-APACHE-2.0 and NOTICE covering the incorporated components, and the other mlx-serve entries use MIT. (5) 'Bit-identical to the composed chain' is the file header's own claim (src/gdn_decode.zig:7), pinned by their tests (step/recur parity src/transformer.zig:65203, recurSeq T-row window 65223, the fold parity cases 65322); a reverted sibling variant once diverged by one bf16 ulp on rare beta inputs (docs/gotchas/engine-mlx.md:234), which is why they call that class of claim a sampling result. (6) 'Kept in fp32 on Flash Next by default' verified: qwen4_exp defaults ssm_state_f32 on (src/model.zig:3222, env default at 2152-2160), and Hadamard packs plus GLM-5 are f32 state regardless (src/model.zig:1190); the gate dtype follows the state under bf16 activations for the same near-one reason (src/gdn_decode.zig:22-27). (7) The fold can be declined per GPU at runtime: a pipeline thread limit below 1024 latches fold_ok false at first dispatch and the caller keeps the unfolded chain (src/gdn_decode.zig:945-955), so engagement is machine-dependent. (8) Their K2 once served block 1024 only and mis-rotated 512/4096-block packs on the one-token forward (docs/gotchas/engine-mlx.md:5704); the pinned revision admits 512, 1024, 2048 and 4096 (src/rht.zig:76), and the guard test runs every block bit for bit against the chain (docs/gotchas/engine-mlx.md:5706). (9) Our doc's 1-node-tree conv-row defect and its guard are in the source history (docs/gotchas/engine-mlx.md:5368-5373) with the stride fix visible at src/gdn_decode.zig:322. (10) The tree prework's restart flag trick means a row whose parent is the previous row does not re-store its state: the walk reads parents[t] once per token and kept[] only on real branches (src/gdn_decode.zig:367-368, 379), which our doc's 'restart states in registers' does not spell out. (11) No number in the repo measures this file's kernels directly; both measured figures belong to neighbouring paths (the composed-chain fusion and the stock recurrence ubench) and are labeled as such in their conditions.
